name: Introduction and overview — MiG-29 — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — MiG-29
description: Introduction and overview of the MiG-29: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The MiG-29 is a twin-engine air-superiority fighter built by Mikoyan, entering service in 1982 as the Soviet answer to the F-15 and F-16. Known for exceptional agility and helmet-mounted-sight dogfighting, about 1,600 have been built. It serves Russia and many export customers; carrier and upgraded variants continue in production. Baseline facts: Twin-engine air-superiority fighter; service from 1982; ~1,600 built by Mikoyan..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: MiG-29: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Twin-engine air-superiority fighter; service from 1982; ~1,600 built by Mikoyan.
